steps.say: Percent means parts in each hundred. The symbol is %. 25% means 25 out of every 100.
If a 10 by 10 grid has 30 squares shaded, then 30 out of 100 are shaded. That is 30%.
50% is 50 out of 100, which is one half. 25% is one quarter. 100% is the whole.
The more equal parts a whole is cut into, the smaller each part is. One fifth is smaller than one third.
A fraction is also a division. 3/4 means 3 ÷ 4. A unit fraction such as 1/5 means 1 ÷ 5.

check.prompt: In a 10 by 10 grid, 40 squares are shaded. What percent of the grid is shaded?
